html_title: StreetZim — Mepu dzeKiwix dzinoshanda pasina indaneti
meta_description: Mepu dzeOpenStreetMap dzemahara, dzinoshanda zvakakwana pasina indaneti, dzakagadzirirwa Kiwix. Matairi evector, mifananidzo yesetiraiti, chimiro chenyika che3D neruzivo rweWikipedia — dzinoshanda pasina indaneti paiOS, Android, Mac, Windows neLinux.
tagline: Mepu dzeOpenStreetMap dzinoshanda zvakakwana pasina indaneti, dzakagadzirirwa Kiwix. Matairi evector, mifananidzo yesetiraiti, chimiro chenyika che3D neWikipedia — hapana indaneti inodiwa.
maps_intro: Sarudza dunhu pazasi, isa Kiwix, wozovhura faira re.zim. Mafaira anochengetwa paInternet Archive — dhaunirodhi yega yega ine torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Sarudza dunhu pazasi woridhaunirodha muchiShona: mazita ari pamepu, kutsvaga neWikipedia zviri muchiShona. Vhura faira racho muKiwix, app yemahara; peji remepu yega yega rinoratidza maitirwo azvo, nhanho nenhanho.
feature_key_intro: Mabheji ari pakadhi rega rega anoratidza zviri mukati:
badge_overture_desc: mawebhusaiti, nhamba dzerunhare nemidhiya yemagariro kubva kuOverture,
what_lead: StreetZim inorongedza data reOpenStreetMap — nyika dzese kana makondinendi ese — mufaira rimwe chete reZIM raunogona kuvhura muKiwix. Inoshanda zvakakwana pasina indaneti: hapana maseva, hapana zvikumbiro zveAPI, uye hapana indaneti inodiwa kana wapedza kudhaunirodha.
what_p2: Kusiyana nemaapp emepu akajairika anoshandisa matairi eraster, StreetZim inoshandisa matairi evector anodhirowewa pamudziyo wako neMapLibre GL JS. Mhedzisiro: kufambisa, kuswededza nekutenderedza mepu zvakanaka, kunyange chimiro chenyika che3D — zvese kubva mufaira rimwe chete riri pamudziyo wako.
feat_vector_p: Mepu dzakajeka, dzinotsvedzerera kusvika pamigwagwa, dzinoshandisa hurongwa hweOpenMapTiles, dzinodhirowewa ipapo ipapo neMapLibre.
feat_sat_p: Mifananidzo yeSentinel-2 isina makore, ine udzamu hwemamita gumi, yedunhu rese riri pamepu.
feat_terrain_p: Mimvuri yemakomo nekukwirira kwe3D kubva kuCopernicus GLO-30, modhero yepasi rese yekukwirira kwenyika.
feat_wiki_p: Bata guta ripi neripi, gomo kana nzvimbo inozivikanwa kuti uone chinyorwa chayo cheWikipedia neruzivo rwayo rwakakosha.
feat_search_p: Tsvaga mumamiriyoni emazita enzvimbo, migwagwa, mapaki, nhongonya dzemakomo, nhandare dzendege nenzvimbo dzinofadza.
feat_offline_p: Faira rimwe chete re.zim. Hapana maakaundi, hapana kuunganidzwa kwedata, hapana netiweki. Vhura wotanga.
step1_p: App yekuverenga yemahara yeiOS, Android, Mac, Windows neLinux. Iwane pakiwix.org. PaWindows neLinux, parizvino vhura mepu muKiwix PWA: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 inodziratidza dzisina chinhu, uye kugadziriswa kwazvo kuchiri mumavhezheni ezuva nezuva (nightly) chete.
step2_p: Sarudza dunhu pamusoro wodhaunirodha faira re.zim (kana kushandisa torrent kuti zvikurumidze).
step2_p_lang: Sarudza dunhu pamusoro wodzvanya bhatani raro rekudhaunirodha: unowana mepu muchiShona, iri faira rimwe chete re.zim.
step3_p: Vhura faira re.zim muapp yeKiwix. Ndizvozvo chete — mepu inoshanda zvakakwana pasina indaneti.
sources_intro: StreetZim yakavakwa zvakakwana nedata rakavhurika. ZIM yemepu yega yega ine zvinhu zvinobva kunzvimbo idzi:
src_map: Data remepu: © Vabatsiri veOpenStreetMap, rinowanikwa pasi peOpen Database License (ODbL).

src_elev: Kukwirira kwenyika: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, rakapihwa pasi pechirongwa cheCOPERNICUS neEuropean Union neESA.
src_place: Ruzivo rwenzvimbo: Wikidata (CC0) neWikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: StreetZim inovimba nemaapp ekuverenga eKiwix kuti ivhure mafaira e.zim. App yega yega iopen source uye inogadzirwa paGitHub:
footer: StreetZim ipurojekiti yeopen source. Kodhi iri paGitHub. Mepu dzinochengetwa paInternet Archive.
card_preview_title: Tarisa mepu iyi mubhurauza rako, ichibva kuarchive.org
card_languages_title: Mepu iyi ine mazita ayo neWikipedia mune mumwe mutauro, ichiumbwa mubhurauza rako
card_download_lang_title: Mepu iyi ine mazita ayo, kutsvaga neWikipedia muchiShona, iri faira rimwe chete re.zim
card_original_title: Mepu sezvayakagadzirwa: mazita enzvimbo ari mumutauro weko; zvekushandisa neWikipedia zviri muChirungu
card_no_lang: Haisati yavapo muchiShona: mepu iyi ine mazita enzvimbo mumutauro weko uye zvekushandisa zviri muChirungu.
mp_html_title: {name}: mepu yeKiwix inoshanda pasina indaneti — StreetZim
mp_meta_description: Mepu yemahara ye{name} inoshanda pasina indaneti, yeapp yeKiwix: migwagwa, nzvimbo, kutsvaga, nzira neWikipedia, muchiShona. Inoshanda pasina indaneti paAndroid, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows neLinux.
mp_lead: Mepu yemahara ye{name} inoshanda pasina indaneti, muapp yeKiwix.
mp_feat_nav: Nzira dzekufamba netsoka, nebhasikoro uye nemota, dzinoverengwa pamudziyo wako.
mp_feat_overture: Zvitoro, maresitorendi nedzimwe nzvimbo, pamwe nemawebhusaiti nenhamba dzerunhare dzadzo.
mp_feat_wiki: Zvinyorwa zveWikipedia zvemaguta, nzvimbo dzinozivikanwa nenzvimbo dzinoshanyirwa.
mp_feat_photo: Tsvaga nemufananidzo: tora mufananidzo wechikwangwani kuti uwane nzvimbo iyoyo pamepu.
mp_dl_lang_note: Mazita ari pamepu, kutsvaga neWikipedia muchiShona, mufaira rimwe chete reKiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Mepu sezvayakagadzirwa: mazita enzvimbo ari mumutauro weko; zvekushandisa neWikipedia zviri muChirungu.
mp_space_note: Usati wadhaunirodha, tarisa kuti mudziyo wako une nzvimbo yakakwana. Mepu hombe dzinodhaunirodhwa zviri nani paWi-Fi.
kg_android_1: Isa Kiwix kubva kuGoogle Play. Ndeyemahara.
kg_android_2: Dhaunirodha mepu iri pamusoro. Foni yako inoichengeta muDownloads.
kg_android_3: Vhura Kiwix, enda kuraibhurari yayo wowedzera faira rawadhaunirodha.
kg_ios_1: Isa Kiwix kubva kuApp Store. Ndeyemahara.
kg_ios_2: Dhaunirodha mepu iri pamusoro. Safari inoichengeta muapp yeFiles, pasi peDownloads.
kg_ios_3: Vhura Kiwix, enda kuraibhurari yayo wovhura faira riri muDownloads.
kg_mac_1: Isa Kiwix kubva kuMac App Store, wozovhura nayo faira rawadhaunirodha.
kg_pc_1: Vhura app yewebhu yeKiwix mubhurauza rako wosarudza faira rawadhaunirodha. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 inoratidza mepu idzi dzisina chinhu; kugadziriswa kwazvo kuchiri mumavhezheni ezuva nezuva (nightly) chete.
kg_offline: Kana wadaro, mepu inoshanda pasina indaneti.
tour_lead: Zvese zviri mumavhidhiyo mapfupi aya zvinoshanda kubva mufaira rimwe chete riri pamudziyo. Akarekodhwa indaneti yakadzimwa; chakazowedzerwa chete mashoko anotsanangura nemadonhwe anoratidza pakabatwa skrini.
tour_photo_h: Tora mufananidzo wechikwangwani, wana nzvimbo yacho
tour_photo_p: Tora mufananidzo wechikwangwani chemugwagwa, chechitoro kana wekero iri pakadhi rekiyi yehotera, mepu yobva yatsvaga nzvimbo yakanyorwa ipapo. Mashoko anoverengwa pamudziyo wako, nemanyorerwo aakaitwa: pano chiUkraine, chiGiriki, chiArabhu, chiJapani, chiKorea, chiChaina neChirungu, zviri padivi nepadivi.
tour_zoom_h: Kubva paguta rese kusvika pachivakwa chimwe
tour_zoom_p: Mepu dzevector dzinoramba dzakajeka pese paunoswededza: bva paKyiv yese kusvika pachivakwa chimwe chete, wozorerekesa nekutenderedza mepu.
tour_drive_p: Nzira inoyambuka Kyiv, yakaverengwa pafoni ikateverwa kona nekona. Yakarekodhwa nenzvimbo yekunyepedzera; chikamu chepakati cherwendo chinoridzwa nekumhanya kwakapetwa kagumi.
tour_terrain_p: Mimvuri yemakomo, chimiro chenyika che3D nemifananidzo yesetiraiti: makomo ari pamusoro peTehran.
tour_signs_p: Kutsvaga kumwe chete nerudzi rwega rwega rwemanyorerwo, pamepu yeguta rine chikwangwani chacho.
tour_credits: Mifananidzo yezvikwangwani, mufananidzo wegedhi nemifananidzo yesetiraiti iri mumavhidhiyo nemaskrinishoti aya ndeyevamwe: ona vakaitora nemarezinesi.
gallery_lead: Maskrini chaiwo emepu, pakombiyuta nepafoni. Sarudza rimwe kuti uriona rakakura, wozopfuurira kune mamwe.
gal_place: Kadhi renzvimbo rine mufananidzo nepfupiso yeWikipedia
gal_find: Wana makafe, zvitoro nezvimwe zviri pedyo
langs_lead: Mazita enzvimbo, kutsvaga, nzira, zvinyorwa zveWikipedia nemamenyu emepu pachayo, mumutauro waunoverenga. Kusanganisira manyorerwo anobva kurudyi achienda kuruboshwe.
langs_step1_p: Usarudze parondedzero iri pazasi, kana pamenyu iri pamusoro pepeji ripi neripi.
langs_step2_p: Papeji remutauro wako, bhatani guru remepu yega yega rinodhaunirodha mepu mumutauro iwoyo, iri faira rimwe chete re.zim. Peji rino reChirungu rinopa mepu yega yega sezvayakagadzirwa: mazita enzvimbo ari mumutauro weko, zvekushandisa neWikipedia zviri muChirungu.
langs_step2_p_lang: Papeji rino, bhatani guru remepu yega yega rinoti “Dhaunirodha muchiShona”: mepu ine mazita enzvimbo, kutsvaga, Wikipedia nemamenyu muchiShona, iri faira rimwe chete re.zim. Kana mepu isati yagadzirwa muchiShona, kadhi rayo rinozvitaura.
langs_step3_p: Mepu zhinji dzinogona kugadzirwawo mumitauro inotaurwa ikoko, sechiCatalan cheIberia kana chiWelsh cheBritain neIreland. Peji rinoti Mepu mune mimwe mitauro rinoratidza mutauro wega wega wemepu yega yega uye rinoumba faira mubhurauza rako.
langs_demo_note: Mepu imwe chete yeKyiv muchiArabhu, chiHebheru, chiHindi, chiThai, chiJapani nechiChaina. Zita risina shanduro rinoramba riri sezvarinonyorwa ikoko.
langs_grid_note: Nhamba inoratidza kuti mepu ngani dzagadzirira mumutauro iwoyo nhasi.
filter_none: Hapana mepu inoenderana nazvo. Edza nyika, dunhu kana guta.
credits_intro: Mavhidhiyo mapfupi nemaskrinishoti anoratidza mepu sezvadziri. Zvikwangwani zviri mukutsvaga nemufananidzo, mufananidzo mumwe wenzvimbo inozivikanwa nemifananidzo yesetiraiti ibasa revamwe, rakashandiswa pasi pemarezinesi aya. Mifananidzo yezvikwangwani yakachekwa.
